interpretation: Selected ISB target definitions for a reproducible D1-D3 audit. Left segments use the mirrored anatomical construction; a target is not evidence that an exporter implements it.

pelvis.selected_option: pelvic coordinate system with functional hip joint centre

axes.X: anterior, in the plane defined by both ASIS and the midpoint of both PSIS
axes.Y: cranial, orthogonal to X and Z
axes.Z: right, along the line joining left ASIS to right ASIS

axes.X: anterior, orthogonal to Y and Z
axes.Z: right, normal to the plane IJ, C7 and midpoint(PX,T8)

head.selected_option: not covered by the selected Wu 2002/2005 segment recommendations

origin.definition: not specified in the selected target

axes.X: anterior, orthogonal to Y and Z
axes.Y: cranial from midpoint of femoral epicondyles to HJC
axes.Z: right, normal to the plane HJC and both femoral epicondyles

origin.definition: midpoint of medial and lateral malleoli (IM)

axes.X: anterior, normal to the tibial torsional plane
axes.Y: cranial, orthogonal to X and Z
axes.Z: right, from medial malleolus to lateral malleolus

foot.selected_option: calcaneal coordinate system in neutral position

axes.X: anterior, normal to the calcaneal frontal plane
axes.Y: cranial, parallel to the tibial longitudinal axis in neutral position
axes.Z: right, orthogonal to X and Y

upper_arm.selected_option: humerus option 2 because forearm data are available

axes.X: anterior, orthogonal to Y and Z
axes.Y: proximal from elbow epicondyle midpoint to GH
axes.Z: right, normal to the plane formed by the humerus and forearm longitudinal axes with the elbow at 90 degrees in the sagittal plane and the forearm fully pronated

axes.X: anterior, normal to the plane US, RS and elbow midpoint
axes.Y: proximal from US to elbow epicondyle midpoint
axes.Z: right, orthogonal to X and Y

hand.selected_option: third metacarpal for global wrist motion

origin.definition: midway between the base and head of the third metacarpal

axes.X: anterior according to the third metacarpal construction
axes.Y: proximal from third metacarpal head to base
axes.Z: right, orthogonal to X and Y
